template.title: The Lost Toy and the Balloon Friend
template.summary: A child finds a lost toy with the help of a friendly animal and learns to keep looking.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] on the park bench.
One sunny day, [[slot_child]] put [[slot_toy]] under a big oak tree.
When [[slot_child]] looked up, the toy was gone.
[[slot_child]] felt sad and wondered where the toy had gone.
A friendly [[slot_pet]] hopped over and asked, "Do you need help?"
The [[slot_pet]] sniffed the air and found a bright [[color]] balloon tied to the tree.
The balloon floated like a rainbow, and the toy was on a tiny leaf.
[[slot_child]] almost gave up, but remembered the [[slot_pet]]'s smile and decided to look again.
[[slot_child]] reached the leaf and got [[slot_toy]] back.
They sat under the tree and watched the clouds.
The day ended with a gentle breeze and a new friendship.
